notes.text:
Description: In Koinly, under Transactions, find every real swap that has no price. RouteV2 alone misses Swap2, SwapTob, BuyExactQuoteIn and Fill.

Filters:
* Warning: Missing prices
* Contract function has any value
* Contract function does not contain MintTo

Prices:
* Enter the custom price in INR, not USD. USD keeps only 2 decimals, so 0.0635 becomes $0.06.
* After the import, open Settings, then Custom prices, and tap the blue "here" to force-update existing transactions. A wallet sync does not apply the price.
Koinly has problem with having more than 2 decimals after cent so better export excel with INR from Solchain analysis.

For Coins Like Cate, we don't see listed under Coingeko or CMC so koinly ll fail to get coin buy price so it ll give warning below saying No market price found and entire price shown as taxable. So go to settings in konily upload custom prices CSV and force it to calculate, after uploading there is link to force else it ll not work..get txn report from solscan using grok give to clade to give price rate CSV and upload that's it
